notes.text: The [printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=203) gives Yose ben Kisma and Shimon bar Kisma. The supplied second marker is בק. Shabbat has Yosei bar Kisma in the first passage and Shimon ben Kisma in the second. In the latter, Shimon speaks in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish, as in [Heilprin’s Shimon entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3468&lang=en).
